name: Shezmu permissionless collateral mint recurrence
summary: A later independent actor used the same permissionless pseudo-WBTC mint path to issue unbacked ShezUSD and remove USDC and sDAI inventory from the ShezUSD liquidity pools.

loss.notes: Four disposal receipts depleted the Curve ShezUSD/USDC pool by 962.224781 + 118.616729 + 142.949383 = 1,223.790893 USDC and the Balancer ShezUSD/sDAI pool by 771.270672279107347817 + 92.720177612173316782 = 863.990849891280664599 sDAI. Each receipt exactly matches the corresponding archive pool-balance delta, with no same-block residual. The two sDAI components are valued at their closest-preceding ERC-4626 DAI conversion values and DAI par. The freely minted pseudo-WBTC and ShezUSD are unbacked pool consideration, not additional scarce-asset loss. Downstream WETH/ETH disposal, retained unbacked ShezUSD, and later return activity are excluded.

ageReset.description: The permissionless mint path is part of the token's immutable direct runtime, deployed in this transaction and unchanged through the recurrence.

sources.note: Archive-RPC review bounded the funding transaction and attacker nonces 0 through 7. Nonce 0 created an ephemeral helper and used the same public mint path as the earlier Shezmu campaign to issue 340,282,366,920,938,463,463.374607431768211455 pseudo-WBTC and 98,999,168,398.02 ShezUSD without scarce collateral. Nonce 1 approved ShezUSD. Nonces 2, 3, 5 and 6 routed unbacked ShezUSD through the two victim pools; nonce 4 moved only unbacked ShezUSD, and nonce 7 returned native funding and ends the bounded campaign. Curve USDC archive deltas are exactly -962.224781, -118.616729 and -142.949383 in the three receipts, while its corresponding ShezUSD inputs are 5,400,000, 10,000,000 and 10,000,000. Balancer pool 0xed0df9cd16d806e8a523805e53cf0c56e6db4d1d000000000000000000000687 falls from 788.853467591609980624 to 17.582795312502632807 sDAI against 4,600,000 ShezUSD in nonce 2, then from 96.652092844373340954 to 3.931915232200024172 sDAI against 10,000,000 ShezUSD in nonce 6. ERC-4626 convertToAssets(1e18) at the preceding blocks is 1.109176937108462931 DAI and 1.109191840595421389 DAI respectively. The exploit helper ends with zero ETH and incident-token balances; routing helper 0xf081470f5c6fbccf48cc4e5b82dd926409dcdd67 retains only its unchanged 1-wei ShezUSD, USDC, sDAI and WETH dust and 48 additional wei of ETH. Uniswap WETH outputs are downstream disposal of the measured victim assets, not additional loss. The incident anchor is nonce 0 at 20794865:155, the earliest successful transaction in this campaign to execute the public mint defect; the first scarce loss follows at nonce 2, 20794884:104. The target is the same direct runtime and selector path as the earlier campaign. It was created at 20666529:69, is absent in the preceding block, has unchanged hash 0x636790363efd966d1c8e3e2459ffcfa5c9729e00b719e5adacb9af494df81673 and contains no delegation. Its age at the causal anchor is 1,548,240 seconds.
